name: Merge Tractography (tcks) together with MRTrix3
summary: Merges multiple tractograms into one .tck file with MRtrix3 tckedit.
description: Concatenates the streamlines of all input .tck tractograms (multi input) into track/track.tck using MRtrix3 tckedit. Use it to combine tractograms generated separately (for example with different algorithms or parameters) for the same subject. All tractograms should be in the same space.

inputs.description: Tractograms (.tck) to merge; several datasets can be selected.

outputs.description: Single .tck tractogram containing the streamlines of all inputs.

failure_modes.fix: Check that the inputs are valid .tck files.
